U(P, f) = ∑_{i=1}^{n} M_i \* (b_i - a_i)

L(P, f) = ∑_{i=1}^{n} m_i \* (b_i - a_i)

|U(P, f) - L(P, f)| ≤ ∑_{i=1}^{n} (M_i - m_i) \* (b_i - a_i)
